method: Deterministic S6-symmetric rotated BCC Chebyshev equilibrium lattice start (angle 6 deg around (1,1,1), boundary offset 0.25 * 2*pi/n, L_12 cutoff, equilibrium weights) solved directly with geodesic-accelerated Marquardt-scaled Levenberg-Marquardt (no randomness); the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Antigravity (AI-assisted)
